payout_quote: Offer available from 6/1/2026 to 12/31/2026. Promo code NM26 required at account opening. Must open a KeyPoint Checking account with $10 minimum opening deposit. $300 direct deposit bonus credited to Checking account in $50 increments over 6 months if: (a) Member establishes recurring qualified monthly direct deposit of at least $1,000 from salary or personal income for 6 consecutive months to Checking account, and (b) first qualifying direct deposit posts within 60 days after account opening.
steps: Qualify for KeyPoint Credit Union membership (CA Bay Area; new members only - no KeyPoint account within the previous two years)
Open a KeyPoint Checking account between 6/1/2026 and 12/31/2026 with promo code NM26 and $10 minimum opening deposit

Establish recurring qualified monthly direct deposit of at least $1,000 from salary or personal income (pension, Social Security, government benefits); first DD must post within 60 days of account opening
Receive the $1,000+ DD each month for 6 consecutive months; $50 credited each qualifying month
Total $300 credited within 9 months of new account opening
catches: Paid in $50/month increments over 6 months - full $300 requires 6 consecutive months of $1,000+ qualifying direct deposits; any interruption forfeits remaining bonus payments
California Bay Area credit union; membership eligibility required
New members only - former members who closed an account within two years of the new account open date are ineligible
Account-to-account transfers, bank-to-bank transfers, card payments, and P2P (Zelle, Venmo) do not qualify; KeyPoint may verify deposit sources
Student and Kids Checking accounts are not eligible; cannot be combined with other promotions; employees/officials and families excluded
biggest_catch: The $300 is paid in $50 monthly chunks and requires $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits every month for 6 straight months - one missed month forfeits the rest.
eligibility: New KeyPoint members only (no KeyPoint account within previous two years); no employees/officials/families; Student and Kids Checking excluded.
timing: Open 6/1/26-12/31/26; first qualifying DD within 60 days; $1,000+/month for 6 consecutive months; total bonus credited within 9 months of account opening.
